Hence A=±z^c·D where D divides x^d+1 ⇒ D is product of distinct even‑index cyclotomics Φ_{2e}. List Φ_{2e} with deg≤8: degs {1,2,2,4,4,4,6,8,6,8,8,8}. Enumerate all subsets with total deg≤8; each gives 2·(9−deg) α (sign·shift). Sum=266. Thus 266 shifty functions.
